title: Sum Check
summary: Re-adds rows in exact arithmetic and points at the likely slip when a total doesn't match, or says it's only rounding.
description: Total checker that re-adds rows in exact integer arithmetic, shows the off-by amount, points at rows that would explain it (swapped digits, slipped decimal, flipped sign, debit on the credit side) and says when the gap is only rounding, with a one-tap use-the-sum fix.
catches: Totals that don't equal the sum of rows
A shifted decimal point, flipped sign or wrong side
A row left out or counted twice
Gaps explained by rounding when decimals are set
limits: Suggests single-row slips only; several errors at once may not be explained
Rounding tolerance depends on the decimals you set
a11y: Status in a polite live region; focus moves to it after a fix
Suspects list has an aria-label; each suspect is a button
